hero.title: Your birth chart, read with clarity.
hero.lead: Astronomia works out your hadahan and porondam from precise planetary positions. Then it explains every result in plain Sinhala or English, for a birth anywhere in the world.
hero.privacy: No sign up. Nothing you enter is stored.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Astronomia works out charts without keeping them. This page says exactly what happens to the details you give.

glance.title: No account
glance.text: You never sign up or sign in.

glance.title: Nothing kept by default
glance.text: A chart or a match is worked out and sent back. Nothing about it is saved.

glance.title: Sharing is your choice
glance.text: Only a share link keeps a copy, for 30 days, and you can delete it sooner.

glance.title: No birth details in logs
glance.text: Logs hold only the page, the result code and the time taken.

sections.title: What you give
body: The date, time and place of birth (or a latitude, longitude and time zone), and a name if you want one. For a match, the same for two people, or only their birth stars.
These are sent in the body of the request, never in the page address, and are used only to work out the result.

sections.title: What is kept
body: Nothing, unless you press Create link in the Share dialog.

Then a copy of that result is kept, in Sinhala and English, with the birth date, time and place line, and the name or names unless you chose to hide them. The link code and its delete code are kept only in a scrambled (hashed) form.
A share link closes after 30 days and is then deleted. The device that made it can delete it sooner.

sections.title: On your device
body: Your last result is kept in this browser tab, so a reload does not lose it. It is cleared when the tab closes.
When you make a share link, its delete code is kept in this browser so you can delete the link later.
There are no cookies, no adverts and no tracking or analytics.

sections.title: Logs
body: The servers record each request's method, page path, result code and time taken. Share codes are hidden in the path. Logs never hold names, birth details or anything you typed.

sections.title: PDF reports
body: A PDF is made on the server when you ask for it and sent straight to you. It is not kept.

sections.title: Who runs the site
body: The pages are served by Vercel. The calculations and the share links run on Render, in Singapore. Fonts and pictures come from the site itself, so your browser does not contact other services.

sections.title: Questions and deletion
body: To delete a share link, open it on the device that made it and press Delete this link.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: Please read these short terms before using the site.

sections.title: What the site is
body: A tool that works out a Sri Lankan birth chart (hadahan) and a marriage match (porondam) from astronomical calculations and traditional rules, in Sinhala and English.

sections.title: For guidance only
body: The results are for guidance and cultural interest. They do not predict events, health or outcomes, and the site never tells anyone whether to marry.
For important decisions, speak with your family and a practising astrologer.

sections.title: Rules can differ
body: Traditions differ, and some rules here are provisional until a practising astrologer confirms them. The pages mark these.

sections.title: Accuracy
body: A result is only as good as the birth time and place given. A few minutes' difference can change the lagna, and the page warns when that is likely.

sections.title: Sharing
body: You choose what to share. Please do not share another person's birth details without their agreement.

sections.title: Fair use
body: Please do not try to break, overload or copy the site in bulk.

sections.title: Changes
body: These terms may change. The date at the top shows the latest version.
